text: Local API bundled with the desktop app that runs on localhost and works fully offline
quote: Our API is now available and directly included with the desktop app, running entirely on localhost. It operates fully offline

text: API lets developers query, retrieve, and update spaces, objects, properties, types, and templates to build extensions
quote: Learn how to query, retrieve, and update spaces, objects, properties, types, and templates to build powerful extensions.

text: API supports creating chats, sending and streaming messages, reacting, and searching chat history
quote: Create chats, send and stream messages, react, and search chat history

text: API supports uploading, downloading, and deleting files in spaces
quote: Upload, download, and delete files in spaces (anytype-heart v0.50.5)

text: Extensible through a gRPC API and AI agents
quote: Extensible through a gRPC API and AI "Agents" (see AGENTS.md).

text: Publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI v2 specification with full schemas and documented error responses
quote: Anytype publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI document at developers.anytype.io/openapi-v2.yaml: info "title: Anytype API", "version: \"2025-11-08\"", with full component schemas and documented error responses ("Unauthorized ... Missing, unk

text: API is versioned with dated releases and a changelog; a pre-release v2 exposes objects as editable JSON documents
quote: The API reference is versioned with dated releases: "API Version: 2025-11-08", a version picker listing "API v2 — pre-release" alongside "API v1" versions "2025-11-08 (latest)", "2025-05-20", "2025-04-22", and a Changelog section. Portal ba

text: Official Anytype CLI runs Anytype as a headless server for automation and scripting
quote: Anytype CLI is now available - run Anytype as a headless server for automation and scripting.

text: Official MCP server lets AI assistants interact with Anytype's API through natural language
quote: The Anytype MCP Server is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enabling AI assistants to seamlessly interact with Anytype's API through natural language.

text: Open-source agent toolkit lets Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot and similar tools read, search, and modify objects
quote: gives AI assistants a safe way to read, search, and modify Objects in your Anytype Channels. Drop it into Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot

text: Agents can run scripts against Anytype data for bulk edits, transformations, and repetitive tasks
quote: the agent can run scripts against your Anytype data — programmatically — to handle bulk edits, transformations, and repetitive tasks

text: Back up data to a self-hosted network using a network configuration, with a team-maintained Docker image
quote: To back up your channels and data to a self-hosted network, you need to have a network configuration... There's also a docker image that's maintained by the team.

text: Local-only mode disables Anytype's backup node, and devices sync only over the same local network
quote: you can enable local-only mode. This mode disables Anytype's backup node entirely—meaning multi-device syncing will only work over the same local network

text: All content is stored locally on the device, so the app works offline-first without an internet connection
quote: All your content is stored locally on your device... This means an offline-first experience: the app always works without an internet connection

text: Data lives in an encrypted Vault that the user owns, stored directly on their device
quote: A **Vault** is an encrypted container in Anytype that you own. Everything you create lives inside your Vault, stored directly on your device.

text: Vendor infrastructure handles background syncing and backups automatically
quote: Our infrastructure handles background syncing and backups automatically, so you retain full ownership of your data

text: Only the user and people they invite can access spaces; not even Anytype can see the content
quote: You control access. Only you can access your spaces and grant access to others — not even Anytype can see your content.

text: Private collaboration with explicitly invited people, using peer-to-peer sync or self-hosting
quote: only the people you explicitly invite have the keys to unlock and view it... You can even collaborate directly with others using peer-to-peer sync or self-host

text: Collaborators can join without an email address, a subscription, or permission from anyone
quote: Collaborators don't need to provide an email address, buy a subscription, or ask anyone for permission.

text: Separate Channels for personal, shared-project, and community or team use
quote: You might keep a personal Channel for private notes and journals, a shared Channel for a project with collaborators, and another for a community or team.

text: Queries define criteria and automatically assemble live, up-to-date results as a View
quote: Rather than manually curating a list of things you're looking for, you define the criteria and the Query assembles the result for you as a View.

text: Composable blocks include text, databases, kanban, calendar, and custom Types
quote: Composable blocks: text, databases, kanban, calendar & custom Types.

text: Users can create custom Types that act as blueprints defining what an object is
quote: Anytype comes with built-in Types, but you can create your own custom Types to match your needs.

text: Live visual Graph maps every object in a Channel and how the objects connect
quote: The Graph is a live, visual map of every Object in your Channel and how they connect to each other.

text: Linking connects separate notes into a knowledge base, with relationships registered as links
quote: Linking on Anytype is what turns a bunch of separate notes into a connected knowledge base.

text: A single note can connect to multiple meetings, clients, and projects without duplication
quote: Your note exists by itself and you can connect it to your Meetings, Clients, and Projects all at the same time. No duplication.

text: Files exist once but can be linked across many objects without duplicates
quote: a file exists once but can be linked across as many Objects as you need — no duplicates, no clutter.

text: Publish any object as a static public webpage on a personal any.org subdomain, using a custom ANY ID
quote: Pick an Object, click Publish, and Anytype generates a static HTML page hosted on your personal subdomain at <your-id>.any.org/<slug>.

text: Import content and export it at any time, so users can leave with their data
quote: You can import content into your spaces and export it at any time.

text: Export in Markdown or the Any-Block format
quote: Choose your preferred format: Markdown or Any-Block.

text: Export all channels and import them into a new identity after switching network mode
quote: export all your channels, and import them into a new identity after switching the network mode

text: Obsidian import creates a separate object for each Markdown file
quote: Open Channel Settings → Import → Obsidian and click on Import files... automatically create a separate object for each Markdown file.

text: Reusable templates provide a predefined starting point for new notes, tasks, or projects
quote: Instead of starting every new Note, Task, or Project from a blank page, you define what a good starting point looks like once

text: Blocks can be dragged, nested, converted to other block types, or arranged into columns
quote: you can drag them, nest them, turn one type into another, or build columns by placing them side by side.

text: Table of Contents block auto-generates from the headings on a page
quote: you can add a Table of Contents block (/toc) to any Object. It auto-generates from the headings on the page

text: Toggled headings collapse to hide the content beneath them
quote: A Toggled Heading is a heading that can be collapsed to hide everything beneath it.

text: Inline LaTeX via $ delimiters and dedicated math blocks via /latex
quote: Wrap mathematical notation with $ symbols to render LaTeX inline... use /latex to created a dedicated math block

text: Bookmark objects fetch a URL's title, description, preview image, and favicon as properties
quote: Anytype fetches metadata from the URL — title, description, preview image, and favicon — and stores them as Properties on the Object.

text: Custom object icons and covers, chosen from a gallery or uploaded
quote: Custom Object icon and cover — appears at the top of the page

text: Sidebar widgets act as real-time interactive lenses, turning pinned and favorite objects into live feeds
quote: Widgets act as real-time lenses into your Channel, allowing you to interact with your content directly from the Sidebar.

text: Sidebar sections can be hidden, reordered, and customized
quote: The Channel Sidebar is divided into sections, which can be hidden, reordered, or fine-tuned to match how you actually work.

text: Personal Favorites and shared Pinned objects visible to everyone in the Channel
quote: My Favorites (just for you) and Pinned (visible to everyone).

text: Account identity is a permanent 12-word recovery phrase key
quote: Your Key is a string of 12 words, also known as a mnemonic phrase, seed phrase, or recovery phrase.

text: Available on macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android
quote: It is available on macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android.
